name: Tenzaki Riri
source:
Riri is a high-school student and the daughter of a director of large pharmaceutical company. Riri is cheerful, energetic and nice. She loves to eat and sleeps a lot.
Riri is a childhhod friend and schoolmate of [url=/c574]Yukino Matsui[/url]. She has romantic feelings towards [url=/c574]Noel[/url], her bodyguard and schoolmate.

[Translated from [url=http://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noel]the Russian Wikipedia[/url].]
